question: How does the original present GraphQL operations and breakpoint editing in detail?
probes: Screenshots of a GraphQL request selected
resolution: Partly settled in deep mode. The original's English BreakpointController table names the editor fields and actions: editable URL (with an Edit URL sheet), method buttons, Status Code, the Continue ⌘. / Execute ⌘⏎ / Abort ⌘\ shortcuts, Abort by with Drop Connection / 503 / 429, Execute All and Continue All, and an "Auto Bring this Window to the Front" option. What is still unknown is the exact visual arrangement and the GraphQL operation panel: no capture of either exists in the workspace, so the POC keeps its own arrangement (method, URL, headers and body fields with the same shortcuts) and derives GraphQL operation name/type/variables from the request text. This does not affect behaviour.
